summaryForNext: No inference, embedder, model storage or real UAR exists in PatientGPT; the deterministic stub is the only runtime and Service mode fails at startup. UAR ships no local engine, so the local inference crate (KnowMe pattern: per-device engines behind InferenceProvider, pinned catalog, RAM preflight, fastembed 384-dim) is both the no-UAR floor and the driver any embedded UAR would need. Open operator decisions carried into analyze: iOS simulator / Android emulator feasibility for the chat model (and device fallback), what 'UAR absent' means on iOS, Android UAR mode, nightly toolchain if UAR is embedded, goal 5 setup under capability inversion, and the target UAR version (baseline read against 1.1.1). Review warnings carried: AG-UI 0.0.59 vs 1.0 split, A2UI catalog-id rejection by UAR, no mobile vector store, no inference owner role, model licensing unverified.
